import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error

TARGET='DE_load_actual_entsoe_transparency'
df=pd.read_csv('opsd_de_load.csv', parse_dates=['utc_timestamp']).set_index('utc_timestamp')
y=df[TARGET].astype(float)

def make_features(y: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    idx=y.index
    x=pd.DataFrame(index=idx)
    for lag in (168,336,504,672,8760):
        x[f'lag_{lag}']=y.shift(lag)
    weekly=x[[f'lag_{lag}' for lag in (168,336,504,672)]]
    x['weekly_mean_4']=weekly.mean(axis=1)
    x['weekly_median_4']=weekly.median(axis=1)
    x['weekly_trend_1_4']=x['lag_168']-x['lag_672']
    h=idx.hour.to_numpy()
    dow=idx.dayofweek.to_numpy()
    doy=idx.dayofyear.to_numpy()
    x['hour_sin']=np.sin(2*np.pi*h/24)
    x['hour_cos']=np.cos(2*np.pi*h/24)
    x['dow_sin']=np.sin(2*np.pi*dow/7)
    x['dow_cos']=np.cos(2*np.pi*dow/7)
    x['doy_sin']=np.sin(2*np.pi*(doy-1)/365.2425)
    x['doy_cos']=np.cos(2*np.pi*(doy-1)/365.2425)
    x['is_weekend']=(dow>=5).astype(int)
    x['year_trend']=(idx.year-idx.year.min()).to_numpy()
    x['is_new_year']=((idx.month==1)&(idx.day==1)).astype(int)
    x['days_from_new_year']=np.minimum(np.abs(doy-1), 10)
    return x

X=make_features(y)
models={
 'ridge': make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), Ridge(alpha=10.0)),
 'hist': HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss='squared_error', max_iter=300, learning_rate=.05, max_leaf_nodes=31, min_samples_leaf=20, l2_regularization=10, random_state=42),
 'extra': ExtraTreesRegressor(n_estimators=300, max_features=0.8, min_samples_leaf=2, n_jobs=-1, random_state=42),
 'rf': RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=250, max_features=0.8, min_samples_leaf=2, n_jobs=-1, random_state=42),
}
for year in (2018,2019):
    start=pd.Timestamp(f'{year}-01-01', tz='UTC'); end=start+pd.Timedelta(days=7)
    train=(X.index<start)&X.notna().all(axis=1)
    test=(X.index>=start)&(X.index<end)
    print('\nYEAR',year,'train',train.sum())
    actual=y.loc[test]
    naive=X.loc[test,'lag_168']
    print('naive',mean_absolute_error(actual,naive), np.mean(np.abs((actual-naive)/actual))*100, mean_squared_error(actual,naive)**0.5)
    for name,model in models.items():
        model.fit(X.loc[train],y.loc[train])
        pred=model.predict(X.loc[test])
        print(name, round(mean_absolute_error(actual,pred),1), round(np.mean(np.abs((actual-pred)/actual))*100,3), round(mean_squared_error(actual,pred)**0.5,1))

start=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01',tz='UTC');end=start+pd.Timedelta(days=7)
train=(X.index<start)&X.notna().all(axis=1);test=(X.index>=start)&(X.index<end)
actual=y.loc[test]
print('\nTARGET train',train.sum())
print('naive',mean_absolute_error(actual,X.loc[test,'lag_168']), np.mean(np.abs((actual-X.loc[test,'lag_168'])/actual))*100, mean_squared_error(actual,X.loc[test,'lag_168'])**0.5)
for name,model in models.items():
